name: knee tuck jump
description: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.
